mapper.select: select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Type as secType, c1.C_Name as secTendereeName, c2.C_Name as snProcureCpyName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, dp.D_Name as secContractingDepartmentName, mn.* from Sec_Solicitation_Notice mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = sec.Sec_Tenderee left join Sys_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = mn.Sn_Procure_Cpy left join SYS_File f on f.FileId = mn.id left join SYS_Department dp on dp.D_ID = sec.Sec_Contracting_Department where mn.Sec_Id = #{secId} and mn.state=7 order by mn.create_time desc limit 1

select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Type as secType, c1.C_Name as secTendereeName, c2.C_Name as snProcureCpyName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, dp.D_Name as secContractingDepartmentName, mn.* from Sec_Solicitation_Notice mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = sec.Sec_Tenderee left join Sys_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = mn.Sn_Procure_Cpy left join SYS_File f on f.FileId = mn.id left join SYS_Department dp on dp.D_ID = sec.Sec_Contracting_Department where mn.id = #{id}
